physical: Gauge invariance — Requiring the laws to be unchanged under local phase changes of the matter fields forces the existence of the gauge fields that carry the forces.
reflected_sentence: In Vibrational Reality, the Demand that Desire remain unchanged under every shift of imagination brings Frequency into being.
rule_reason: A symmetry keeps its shape: an invariance that forces a structure into existence reflects as a Demand that calls forth Frequency.
interpretation: The symmetry keeps its shape because there is no cost and no resistance. Desire stands for the invariance requirement; Frequency is the partner that the requirement calls into existence.
closing: The rule decided on its own: symmetry, no costs, keeps shape. The only ambiguity was choosing Demand for the invariance requirement; that is a lexical gap, not a rule gap.
